native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 'initial', 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off', 'bargraph1': 'all segments off'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. All components start in off state: both LEDs off and all 10 segments of the bar graph unlit.'}

test2: {'time': 'after 5 button presses', 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off', 'bargraph1': 'first 5 segments lit'}, 'description': 'After 5 button presses, the counter is 5. The bar graph lights up the first 5 segments (A1 to A5). The overflow counter is 0, so both LEDs remain off.'}

test3: {'time': 'after 11 button presses', 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'off', 'bargraph1': 'first segment lit'}, 'description': 'After 11 button presses, the counter has overflowed once (counter reset to 0 then incremented to 1). The overflow counter is 1 (binary 01), so LED1 is on and LED2 is off. The bar graph lights up the first segment (A1).'}

test4: {'time': 'after 20 button presses', 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'on', 'bargraph1': 'first 9 segments lit'}, 'description': 'After 20 button presses, the counter has overflowed twice (counter reset twice, then incremented to 9). The overflow counter is 2 (binary 10), so LED1 is off and LED2 is on. The bar graph lights up the first 9 segments (A1 to A9).'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
